style: Bright, soft 3D cartoon animation for children, vivid happy colours, lively camera movement, joyful energy, no text, no letters, no words, no signs on screen.

words.scene: A cheerful cartoon girl singer with a microphone sings and jumps on a colourful school stage under bright spotlights, while a crowd of happy children in front wave their hands and dance.
A big group of happy cartoon children and their parents dance together in a sunny school yard, clapping hands, stomping their feet and jumping, colourful balloons and bunting all around.
A fun cartoon kids band plays on stage: a boy blows a shiny trumpet, a girl bangs the drums, another boy plays a big golden tuba, musical notes and confetti float in the air.
Cartoon children on stage and the whole crowd in front throw their arms up and cheer together as confetti and streamers fall under golden stage lights, a joyful celebration.
